notable.description: An interactive logon for kdurand arrived through the corporate VPN gateway with multi-factor authentication satisfied, which is the normal way remote staff connect, so it is flagged only because it originates outside the office network.

A workstation sent 40 megabytes of data to the company's own GitHub organisation over a standard code-push connection, which is a large transfer worth noting even though the destination is the organisation's approved repository.
The backup server sent a very large amount of data to external cloud storage, but this matches a scheduled nightly backup job rather than any unusual activity.

The endpoint protection process briefly opened a handle to the process that holds Windows credentials, but this is a normal part of its scheduled scanning routine and is not linked to any other suspicious activity.

summary: Across the day's telemetry, activity consists of routine logons, file access, software updates and standard administrative tasks, with a handful of individually noteworthy but explainable events. No sequence of actions ties these events together into a connected attack, so no attack chain is reported.
